purpose: Freeze the five unweighted K2 students, select a development-only cross-fitted calibrator, and freeze a leakage-controlled deployment threshold.

frozen_model.source: V2-05A H0, exactly reproducing V2-04 K2

deployment_ensemble.aggregation: arithmetic mean of five raw student logits
deployment_ensemble.reason: Four of five deployment members were trained on each development row; no in-sample ensemble score is used or reported.

calibration.cross_fitting: For calibration validation fold f, fit only on honest H0 OOF predictions from folds != f and apply to fold f.

candidates.C1: Platt logistic calibration on raw student logit; unregularized maximum likelihood
candidates.C2: isotonic regression on raw student logit; out_of_bounds=clip

threshold.cross_fitting: For validation fold f, maximize MCC on the other four folds; apply that threshold only to fold f.

prohibited: post-hoc calibrators, threshold grids, or gate relaxation
